sources.snippet: 6DRepNet — Head pose estimation (LiteRT GPU) Real-time 6-DoF head pose estimation running fully on the LiteRT CompiledModel GPU. 6DRepNet (ICIP 2022) regresses a continuous 6D rotation from a face crop — yaw / pitch / roll for driver-monitoring, AR, and attention. ~21 ms/frame on a Pixel 8a.

sources.snippet: The LiteRT catalog ships three verified .litertlm models — Gemma 4 E2B, Gemma 4 E4B, and Qwen3 0.6B — plus instructions for loading gated Gemma models with your own HuggingFace token.
